body:
Use these worthwhile 2026 retest TTPs from your list, prioritized for likely Blocked / high-signal outcomes:

1. T1068 — Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
Best prevention test. Focus: vulnerable driver/BYOVD or known local privilege-escalation behavior.
2. T1558.004 — AS-REP Roasting
Strong AD credential-access test. Focus: accounts with  Do not require Kerberos preauthentication .
3. T1547.002 — Authentication Package
High-impact persistence. Focus: LSA authentication package registry/DLL persistence.
4. T1547.005 — Security Support Provider
Similar LSASS-adjacent persistence, often high-signal for EDR.
5. T1528 — Steal Application Access Token
Very relevant for cloud/SaaS ransomware paths. Focus: browser, CLI, OAuth, cloud-token access.
6. T1071.002 — File Transfer Protocols
Keep it because your old outcome was Blocked - Not Alerted. Retest to see if alerting improved.
